mathematical_status: proved route obstruction for the ordinary additive-network instantiation

arcs: B -> sink with capacity |Q| (or M_B after reserve closure)
attempted_exact_network.conclusion: This network exactly restates the two scalar shortages (R_A-S_m)_+ and (D_B-|Q|)_+. It has no node or cut capable of distinguishing B-same from B-opposite; those are conditionally selected geometric witnesses, not scalar cut types.

no_go_lemma.statement: The existing opposite-star conservation quantities cannot be the capacities of an ordinary additive resource network whose flow certifies distinct budget payment. In A_L+ell(t-1)=2mu+E_A+E_B, the mu missing leaf pairs are one set of actual Q edges but occur with coefficient two, E_A is an incidence deficit whose consequence is a nonlinear anticomplete-rectangle lower bound, and the left side is synchronization defect plus an isolated-leaf correction rather than repeated-colour demand.
proof: The actual B-reserve theorem gives |Q|>=mu+E_B because the missing leaf pairs and external B incidences are disjoint actual missing B-edges. It does not give two disjoint copies of the mu leaf pairs.

If an additive network gives these existing distinct resources their literal capacities, its total on the right is mu+E_A+E_B, which is smaller than the conserved quantity 2mu+E_A+E_B by exactly mu whenever mu>0.

If the network instead places two capacity-one arcs for each missing leaf pair, a two-unit flow may use two copies of the same edge of Q. Such a flow is not an injection into missing edges and cannot certify D_B<=M_B.
The published elimination avoids this double spending by the nonlinear inequality Q+min(Q,binom(ell,2))+E_A >= A_L+ell(t-1). The second Q term is a bound on the same mu, not new reserve capacity.

E_A=sum_(c in L)|Y\N(c)| is also not a set of missing-A tokens. It first forces |Y|>=(H+eta)/ell; together with |N_A(b)|>=H/alpha this yields the product M_A>=ceil(H/alpha)ceil((H+eta)/ell). This product transference is not additive flow conservation.

Finally S_m=e-binomial(|B|,2)-Phi(n,e) is a global numerical slack with no inherited colour-by-colour or witness-by-witness ownership map. Connecting every A-residual unit to a generic S_m pool merely assumes the absorption R_A<=S_m that the proof needs to establish.
no_go_lemma.minimal_leaf_ledger: Take two isolated leaves: ell=2, t=2, mu=1, E_A=E_B=A_L=0. The exact conservation identity reads 0+2(2-1)=2*1. There is one actual missing leaf pair, not two reserve tokens; moreover the left-hand 2 includes the isolated-leaf correction and is not two units of D_A or D_B.
no_go_lemma.scope: This refutes the proposed ordinary additive max-flow/min-cut realization from existing branch quantities. It does not rule out a polymatroidal/submodular-flow certificate after new ownership and overlap data are proved.
